modalities.evidence: H&E whole slide images (WSIs) manually annotated for tumor regions of interest (ROIs)

output.population: Patients with HER2-positive breast cancer, including pre-treatment samples from HER2+ patients that subsequently received trastuzumab therapy
output.summary: Hematoxylin and eosin whole slide images with pathologist-annotated tumor regions of interest, used to train classifiers predicting HER2 status and trastuzumab treatment response in breast cancer.
